title: AI references can look way too real
caption: AI references can look convincing. I use Citely to check the source trail before relying on one.
pinned_comment: This is your sign to check AI references before trusting them.
script_lines: AI references looking real is actually terrifying
so I do not trust the citation blindly
check the title, authors, and source details
and if I only have a claim, I can find sources too
not every academic-looking citation deserves trust
